top_signals.title: Bonds Become ‘Really Difficult to Trade’ as Correlations Unwind
top_signals.summary: Bond traders face a welter of confusion as fixed-income markets respond more to geopolitical risk and inflation rather than taking cues from traditional signals like US economic growth, according to AlphaSimplex Group’s Kathryn Kaminski.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
